tasks.label: SimCore: Flash
tasks.detail: Flashes an already built directory over ${input:serialPort}
args: -lc

source "${workspaceFolder}/tools/idf-env.sh" ${input:buildDirectory} >/dev/null && DIRECTORY=${input:buildDirectory} && { [ -f $DIRECTORY/project_description.json ] || { echo "Run the SimCore build task for $DIRECTORY first."; exit 1; }; } && ESPBAUD=460800 idf.py -B $DIRECTORY -p ${input:serialPort} flash
